Historyedit

The harbour authority said on Tuesday that the new ferry timetable would take effect in spring, after months of consultation with residents, traders and the island councils. Critics argued that the plan favoured visitors over people who live on the islands all year, and asked for earlier crossings on weekdays so that workers and students could travel without a long wait.
